coordinate_model: integer coordinates identify cell centers; every cell is the closed square [x-1/2,x+1/2] x [y-1/2,y+1/2]

center_cells.rule: sample every integer coordinate on the major axis and select the nearest minor-axis cell center
center_cells.tie: include both equally near cell centers at an exact half-cell tie
center_cells.endpoint_order: normalize the increasing major axis before evaluation
center_cells.reason: the set remains invariant under endpoint reversal, integer translation, reflection, and 90-degree rotation

supercover_cells.rule: include every closed cell square having a non-empty intersection with the closed center-to-center segment
supercover_cells.boundary: edge-only and corner-only contact are included
supercover_cells.arithmetic: test oracle scales coordinates by two and uses exact rational slab intersection

line_radius: take the unique union of the selected metric offsets around every line seed cell

endpoint_policy.distinct: remove excluded start/end seeds before dilation and remove the exact excluded endpoint coordinate again after dilation
endpoint_policy.start_equals_end: the point is a seed when include_start OR include_end is true; both false produces an empty candidate set

bounds_policy.reject: if any theoretical candidate is outside a positive bounded extent, reject the whole operation before mutation
bounds_policy.clip: intersect the complete candidate set with the extent
bounds_policy.unbounded: no clipping is applied; checked finite line/radius limits remain mandatory

topology: NAVGRID_DIR_4 and NAVGRID_DIR_8 do not affect geometry
determinism: candidate membership is a pure function of inputs and options; no RNG or seed exists
unsupported: unknown coverage, metric, direction mode, or invalid extent is rejected without fallback

resource_limits.max_cells_zero: invalid; unlimited enumeration is not accepted
resource_limits.limit_failure: NAVSYS_STATUS_LIMIT_REACHED before caller output replacement or mutation
resource_limits.workspace: seed vector and open-addressed unique-coordinate table are capacity-planned before the hot loop

reference.line_domain: all ordered endpoint pairs in [-3,3] x [-3,3]

production_stage_3.reason: mutation, provenance, cancellation, and final status mapping are owned by stages 4 and 5

production_stage_4.navgrid_integration: a successful carve appends an open overlay generation instead of overwriting the stored navcell
production_stage_4.precedence: the newest matching open or named blocked overlay generation wins; stored terrain and the default blocked layer have generation zero
production_stage_4.provenance: existing blocked overlay layers and their removal tokens remain intact after carving
production_stage_4.stored_forbidden_only: select only candidates whose stored base navcell terrain is TERRAIN_TYPE_FORBIDDEN
production_stage_4.effective_blocked: invoke the bound canonical query with its actual userdata; only the built-in navgrid query is mutable by the open overlay
production_stage_4.query_only_callback: a custom callback result is observed but never reported as removed because the callback-owned state cannot be mutated
production_stage_4.dry_run: compute the same effective changed count without committing an open overlay
production_stage_4.atomicity: validate and prepare a copied overlay state, then commit by swap; OOM, callback failure, unsupported input, and geometry limit failure preserve grid state and caller outputs
production_stage_4.reason: final options, cancellation, partial-result, and public status surfaces are owned by stage 5

options_abi.versioning: struct_size and abi_version are mandatory; reserved0 must be zero
options_abi.unknown_enum_or_flag: NAVSYS_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED without mutation or caller-output replacement

status_mapping.no_change: NAVSYS_STATUS_OK with out_changed_count equal to zero
status_mapping.allocation_failure: NAVSYS_STATUS_OUT_OF_MEMORY; no C++ exception crosses the C ABI
status_mapping.callback_exception: NAVSYS_STATUS_CALLBACK_FAILED; no C++ exception crosses the C ABI

checkpoints: each 64 collected seeds or expansion candidates
cancellation.callback: called synchronously on the calling thread; callback and userdata are borrowed for the call; reentry or mutation of the same navgrid is forbidden

production_stage_5.atomic: NAVGRID_CARVE_ATOMIC and NAVGRID_CARVE_DRY_RUN preserve grid state and the caller output on every failure; successful atomic mutation commits by one overlay-state swap

non_atomic.commit_order: selected candidates in deterministic y,x row-major order
non_atomic.partial_output: after commit processing begins, failure reports the exact number of cells changed by completed chunks, including zero; failures before commit processing preserve the caller output
non_atomic.retry: retrying the same call is deterministic and idempotent because already-open cells are not counted again

production_stage_5.dry_run: returns the same changed count without committing an overlay
